kernel: the dense quantized GEMV/GEMM ladder: qmv/qmv2/qmv3 one-row decode matvecs, qmvf shared-input matvecs with the RMSNorm folded, the qmvh/qmvht half inner-product 3-row verify GEMVs, qmms register-streaming short-prefill GEMMs, and the prefill GEMM tiles (qmr register-MMA default, qmm threadgroup-dequant fallback)
summary: One dispatch ladder serves every dense MLX-affine matmul by row count: one-row decode runs qmv2 (or qmv3 above K 4096) with shift-free in-register dequant, shared-input projection groups run qmvf with the norm folded, the 3-row speculative draft pass runs qmvh half inner products (qmvhts shifted-nibble build on M5 after NaN rows under its fast-math compiler), short prefills up to 128 rows run qmms (weights streamed straight into simdgroup A operands, no staging) or qmr short row tiles, and M >= 64 prefill runs the qmr register-MMA tiles with qmm's threadgroup-dequant tiles as the NI_QMM=0 fallback. The prefill GEMM tiles are a large distinct group inside this entry (their own shape gates and tile table below). mm.metal holds no matmul at this rev: it is image embed rows and M-RoPE attention prep (see notes).

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.quant: MLX affine 4-bit, group 64, bf16 scales and biases (20.2 GB pack); hidden 5120, DeltaNet value 6144, MLP 17408 per qmv.metal:319-320
models.machine: tuned and benched on M4 Pro 48 GB in the source comments; README tables add M5 Max 128 GB, M5 Pro 48 GB, M3 Pro 36 GB, M1 Pro 16 GB

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
models.quant: MLX affine 4-bit group 64 MoE, 3B active; GGUF imports run 6-bit (Q5_K) projections and 4-bit group 32 (Q4_K) LM heads on the M1
models.machine: M4 Pro 48 GB and M1 Pro 16 GB in the source comments; README tables through M5 Max 128 GB

models.name: Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B
models.machine: M4 Pro 48 GB (bench_qmvf 4B shapes) and M1 Pro 16 GB (bench_qmm tile A/B)

settings.name: gemv_threads_per_simdgroup
settings.condition: always (one simdgroup per Metal spec; the lane K stride is 32 * VPL)

settings.name: decode_rows_per_simdgroup
settings.condition: enc_qmv one-row matvec with N < 65536; huge LM-head-like matrices take 4
settings.note: Tuned on M4 Pro per the comment at src/model/qwen35.cpp:1880: huge matrices (lm_head) 4 rows x 4 simdgroups, the rest 2 x 8

settings.name: decode_simdgroups_per_threadgroup
settings.condition: N < 65536 (256 threads); 4 when N >= 65536 (128 threads)

settings.name: decode_gemv_grid
settings.value: (N + rows * nsg - 1) / (rows * nsg) threadgroups of 32 * nsg threads, one row
settings.condition: always for enc_qmv

settings.name: decode_gemv_values_per_lane
settings.condition: the v16 instantiations; v32 forms are compiled for A/B

settings.name: decode_gemv_group_size
settings.condition: every qmv instantiation (GS 64)

settings.name: decode_dequant_form
settings.value: shift-free in-register: masked nibble (w & (mask << BITS*j)) == q * 2^(BITS*j) times x pre-scaled by 2^-(BITS*j), one AND + convert + FMA per value; no materialized fp16 weights
settings.condition: always for the qmv family

settings.name: decode_rows_clamped
settings.condition: rows past N are computed redundantly on clamped rows and never stored, so lanes never diverge

settings.name: gemv_rmsnorm_fused
settings.condition: the *_norm builds fold the RMSNorm into the x load (weight nw, bf16)

settings.name: wide_k_gemv_x_tile
settings.condition: qmv2 stages the whole K <= 4096 vector once per threadgroup; qmv3 walks any K in 4096-wide tiles (the 27B's hidden 5120, DeltaNet 6144, MLP 17408)

settings.name: wide_k_gemv_rows_per_simdgroup
settings.condition: qmv3_b4_r2 / qmv3_b8_r2 picks when K > 4096 (rows forced to 2 for 8-bit or residual)

settings.name: multi_segment_max_matrices
settings.condition: qmv_multi / qmv2_multi / qmv3_multi shared-input groups (attention q/k/v, GDN qkv|z|b|a), threadgroups partitioned by tg_begin

settings.name: fused_gate_up_rows
settings.condition: mlp_gate_up: fused RMSNorm + gate/up SwiGLU decode GEMV, any K

settings.name: qmvf_token_rows
settings.condition: the only shipped instantiation; the host gate admits R in 1..2
settings.note: bench_qmvf, 4B shapes, M4 Pro: token rows sharing a thread's dequantization (t2-t4) cost 1.06-1.12x the t1 grids at 2 rows; next-step prefetch spilled at 96 GPRs; the interchanged loop 2-6% slower (src/kernels/qmvf.metal:194-197)

settings.name: qmvf_rows_per_simdgroup
settings.condition: qmvf_*_t1_r4: 2 simdgroups x 4 rows = 64-thread threadgroups, one threadgroup per token row

settings.name: qmvf_max_shared_matrices
settings.condition: enc_qmvf gate (the gate/up form takes exactly 2)

settings.name: qmvf_norm_fold
settings.value: RMSNorm folded: inv = rsqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) scales the finished dot product, each simdgroup gets sum(x^2) from the x it loads anyway; x read once, no staging or barrier, reassociation against the staged kernels is rounding only
settings.condition: the *_norm builds

settings.name: qmvh_token_rows
settings.condition: R == 3 verify rows (the 3-row draft pass); t2 and t4 forms are compiled

settings.name: qmvh_rows_per_simdgroup
settings.condition: the qmvht(_s)_t3_r4 dispatch: 4 rows x 8 simdgroups

settings.name: qmvh_reduction_dtype
settings.value: half inner products: dequant shared across rows, 16-value partial sums accumulate in half, promoted to fp32 with the group scale and bias
settings.condition: always for qmvh/qmvht (the fp32 kernels are the fallback)

settings.name: qmvht_k_tile
settings.condition: qmvht_t3_r4 (NT <= 3); the NT = 4 builds stage 2048-half tiles

settings.name: apple10_qmvh_variant
settings.value: qmvhts_t3_r4 (each nibble shifted down to 0..15, x unscaled)
settings.condition: Apple10 (M5) GPUs; the masked qmvht_t3_r4 build NaNs under their fast-math compiler
settings.note: src/kernels/verify.metal:2110-2115: Apple10 fast-math reassociates the 3- and 4-row builds so the 2^-4j pre-scales land after the masked-weight sums; those sums (up to 61440|x| per term) overflow half once |x| passes ~0.4 and inf - inf gives NaN rows; finite under NI_MATH_SAFE=1, with explicit fmas, or x pre-scaled in threadgroup memory; the shifts cost nothing measurable

settings.name: qmms_rows_per_simdgroup
settings.condition: qmms short prefill: a simdgroup owns 8 weight rows, each lane loads 16 contiguous codes per 64-group

settings.name: qmms_token_block_rows
settings.condition: qmms_b*_t1..t8 hold T <= 8 * TB with TB <= 8, so 64 rows per dispatch and up to 128 via NI_SHORTPF_EXACT row groups

settings.name: qmms_dequant_form
settings.value: in-register half2 A operands: (nibble | 0x64006400) as exact half 1024 + code, minus 1024, one fma with (scale, bias); exactly qmm's half(s*q + b) up to the fma's single rounding
settings.condition: always for qmms (4- and 8-bit)

settings.name: qmms_no_threadgroup_staging
settings.condition: main path has no threadgroup memory and no barriers; K may split over the threadgroup's simdgroups (ks > 1) with a fixed-order sum

settings.name: qmms_simdgroups_per_threadgroup
settings.condition: enc_qmms dispatches 32 * nsg = 256 threads

settings.name: qmms_k_split_simdgroups
settings.condition: K < 4096 -> 4, K >= 4096 -> 8 (halved until it divides the 8 simdgroups and leaves >= 2 groups per slice); NI_QMMS_KS overrides
settings.note: bench_qmms on M4 Pro per the comment at src/model/qwen35.cpp:2438

settings.name: qmms_row_group_thresholds
settings.condition: NI_QMMS_TY=1 splits 8-row token blocks over grid.y when a dispatch has fewer than 24 * cores / 5 threadgroups, targeting 32 * cores / 5 (96 and 128 on the 20-core M4 Pro); bitwise equal per output

settings.name: qmr_dequant_location
settings.value: MMA registers: weights go device -> registers and never touch threadgroup memory; X is staged in threadgroup memory in the permuted K order the A fragments consume
settings.condition: always for qmr/qmrs/qmr8 (the qmm tiles materialize instead)

settings.name: qmr_default_tile
settings.note: NI_QMM adoption comment, src/model/qwen35.cpp:153-154: 27B prefill 4k +19-21%, 35B +6-8%, greedy output identical; the tile runs 128 threads, 80 GPRs, no stack (src/kernels/qmm3.metal:462)

settings.name: qmr_threads
settings.condition: w14 layouts (WM 1 x WN 4); the M1 tile and the M <= 8 tiles run 64; max_total_threads_per_threadgroup(WM * WN * 32)

settings.name: qmr_m1_tile
settings.condition: Apple7 (M1) family
settings.note: bench_qmm on the M1 Pro, 2048-row chunks of the 4B/9B projections: 3.07-3.17 TFLOP/s against 2.53-2.69 for qmr_k32_w14_m32_n128 on all 9 shapes (src/model/qwen35.cpp:170-173)

settings.name: qmr_small_m_tiles
settings.value: M <= 8: qmr_k64_w12_m8_n64 (BM 8, BN 64, 64 threads); M < 64 or N <= 64: qmr_k64_w14_m16_n64 (BM 16, BN 64, 128 threads)
settings.condition: large-prefill qmr path

settings.name: qmr_short_prefill_row_tiles
settings.value: one BM row tile holds all rows up to 48 (m24/m40/m48/m56 forms; two tiles to 128; gate/up tiles at most 32), so each weight is read and dequantized once (twice) per pass instead of once per 16-row tile
settings.condition: NI_SHORTPF tile mode: R = 1 up to 48 rows, 2 above; BM = 8 * ceil(ceil(M / R) / 8), BN 64 (32-wide measured slower on every 35B/27B shape)

settings.name: qmr_dequant_encode
settings.value: (nibble | 0x34003400) as exact half 0.25 + q/4096, minus 0.25, one half2 fma with (4096 * scale, bias); both factors stay normal halfs only for scales in [1.5e-8, 16]
settings.condition: always for the 4-bit qmr forms (a plain half scale would go subnormal for 2162 scales of the 27B, 14818 of the 35B's dense projections)

settings.name: qmr_no_double_buffer
settings.condition: one X buffer, two barriers per K step; a two-buffer one-barrier variant and a register-prefetch variant measured no faster (prefetch costs registers and spills)

settings.name: qmr8_tiles
settings.value: M >= 64 and N > 64: qmr8_k32_w14_m32_n128 (MFAST grid variant on the M1); M < 64 or N <= 64: qmr8_k32_w14_m16_n64; fused gate/up qmr8_gu_k32_w14_m(32|16)_n64
settings.condition: 8-bit g64, K % 64 == 0, NI_QMM8 = 1 and not the MoE router/shared-expert gate (mode 2 serves those too)
settings.note: 1.4-1.5x qmm_b8_m32_n32 per the NI_QMM8 comment, src/model/qwen35.cpp:2312-2313

settings.name: qmm_tile_bk
settings.condition: the qmm_b4/qmm_b8 fallback tiles: one BK step is half a 64-group, PAD 8

settings.name: qmm_dequant_location
settings.value: threadgroup memory: W tiles dequantized to half in shared memory behind two barriers per BK step, then simdgroup MMA from staging
settings.condition: the qmm_* fallback (and the original default before NI_QMM)

settings.name: qmm_threads
settings.condition: 4 simdgroups in a 2x2 layout, each computing (BM/2) x (BN/2) with 8x8 simdgroup matrices

settings.name: qmmk64_status
settings.value: A/B only: BK 64 variant with half the barriers, no faster than qmm_b4
settings.condition: not dispatched by the host at this rev

settings.name: short_prefill_max_rows
settings.condition: NI_SHORTPF_MAX default and cap; small_t gate for the short-prefill families (qmms/qmr short tiles)

gates.condition: enc_qmv huge matrices: N >= 65536 -> 4 rows x 4 simdgroups, else 2 rows x 8
enc_qmv kernel pick: q4, or q8 with a norm and K <= 4096 -> qmv2_b{bits}_g64_r{rows}; K > 4096 -> qmv3_b{bits}_r{rows}; q8 any K -> qmv3_b8_r2; other formats -> wfmt qmvg_{fmt}_r{rows}
enc_qmvf (shared-input, norm folded) fires when R in 1..=2, 1..4 segments, one common bits value in {4, 8} (or the b6/g32 cases), shared K, K % 64 == 0; else qmv2_multi_r2 / qmv3_multi_r2
multi-segment kernel pick: K > 4096 -> qmv3_multi_r2, else qmv2_multi_r2
qmvf 6-bit (GGUF Q5_K projections): R == 1, IQ model, Apple7 (M1) only; NI_QMVF6=0 off
qmvf 4-bit group 32 (GGUF Q4_K LM heads): one matrix, non-IQ, Apple7 only
verify ladder, R == 1 (a chained MTP draft pass): the decode qmv kernels (NI_MTP_V8=0 restores qmvr)
verify ladder: R >= v8_rows_min or bits not 4/8 -> the 8-row MMA GEMM (X8 tables + enc_qmm8)
v8_rows_min: 3 on dense models, 5 on MoE models; NI_V8=1 -> 2, NI_V8=0 -> 5
verify ladder, R == 2 -> qmvrc1: one single-row threadgroup per (row, 8-row weight block), 64 threads, so the pair shares each weight block through the cache
verify ladder, R == 3 and bits == 4 and not NI_NO_QMVH and not no_qmvh_ -> qmvht_t3_r4 (qmvhts_t3_r4 on Apple10)
verify ladder, K > 4096 -> qmvr4_b{bits}_t{R} tiled staging (plus _v8 for 4-bit R >= 3)
verify rows above 8 do not exist: kMaxVerify = 8
Qwen4Exp sets no_qmvh_ = true: 3-row verify GEMVs run the fp32 kernels instead of qmvht_t3_r4's half products (accuracy first)
short prefill: small_t = NI_SHORTPF on and 1 <= T <= NI_SHORTPF_MAX (default and cap 128)
short prefill, qmms form: at most 64 rows per dispatch (8 blocks of 8 rows) unless NI_SHORTPF_EXACT row groups extend it; the kernels hold 8 token blocks at most

NI_SHORTPF_GEMM=auto family rule (short_qmms): qmms when M <= 8, or M <= 16, or (weight bytes < 24e6 and M <= 56; gate/up: bytes < 24e6 or M <= 56); single-matrix K >= 12288 goes to the qmr tiles from 9 rows
NI_SHORTPF_EXACT family rule (exact_qmms): qmms for every row count when weight bytes < 32e6 and (multi-segment or K < 12288), else the qmr k64 tiles

large prefill 4-bit g64 (qmr): M <= 8 -> qmr_k64_w12_m8_n64; M < 64 or N <= 64 -> qmr_k64_w14_m16_n64; M >= 64 -> qmr_sel().name (default qmr_k32_w14_m32_n128, Apple7 qmr_k64_w12_m32_n64); gated behind NI_QMM != 0

large prefill 8-bit g64: qmr8_k32_w14_m16_n64 when M < 64 or N <= 64, else qmr8_k32_w14_m32_n128 (MFAST variant on the M1); NI_QMM8 mode 1 keeps the trunk's MoE router and shared-expert gate off it (8-bit there changes routing near-ties)
M >= 64 where the tensor units are usable (M5 family on macOS 26): 4-bit g64 goes to qmt_m64_n64 ahead of qmr; 6-bit g64 to qmt6_m64_n64
fallback when NI_QMM=0 or the format has no qmr form: M >= 64 and 4-bit -> qmm_b4_m64_n64, else qmm_b{bits}_m32_n32 (128 threads)
qmr host requirements: bits 4, gs 64, K % 64 == 0, X rows 16-byte aligned (x_ld % 8 == 0)
qmms host requirements (qmms_ok): q4 or q8 or a wfmt-supported format, K % 64 == 0, N > 0

qmms MoE small-T hybrid (qmms_moe2): an expert's first tile with 1 or 2 rows takes the FMA matvec form, larger experts the 8-row MMA (later tiles of a large expert take MMA so pair arithmetic depends on routing alone); qmms_moe3 (NI_SHORTPF_EXACT) runs FMA-equivalent arithmetic for every row count
qmms MoE tiles: N % 8 == 0 (checked on the host)

measured.conditions: 16K cached prefix, one chunk of new rows, short-prefill vs tensor_ops GEMM: 73 rows 679 -> 399 ms, 124 rows 1005 -> 483 ms

measured.model: 2048 x 8192 x 2048 GEMM (4-bit group 32; a 40-layer stand-in of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B reads 4096 tokens in 8.15 vs 9.07 s)

lab_mapping.note: kapitsa picked 2x8 vs 4x4 by an M4 Pro tune; the tslab axis can reproduce that A/B

notes: Doc-vs-source and caveats. (1) mm.metal: the work order placed it in this family, but at rev 14d1b03 it holds embed_rows_bf16 and attn_prep_m (image embedding rows and multimodal M-RoPE attention prep) and no matmul; sided with the source. (2) The qmvh half-precision form lives in verify.metal here, not qmv.metal. Our doc's line that qmvh 'can NaN under fast-math per its own comment' is confirmed and narrower than it reads: only the 3- and 4-row builds, only Apple10 (M5) fast-math reassociation, 2-row builds keep the 2^-4j pre-scales, the output is finite under NI_MATH_SAFE=1 or explicit fmas, and the shipped fix is the shifted-nibble qmvhts_t3_r4 on Apple10 (shifts cost nothing measurable). (3) qmvf.metal's header says R <= 4 token rows, but only t1 instantiations ship and the host gate admits R in 1..2; t2-t4 were dropped on bench_qmvf evidence (1.06-1.12x t1). (4) Our doc's 'no materialized FP16 buffer' claim holds for kapitsa's decode GEMVs, but its qmm prefill materializes dequantized half weight tiles in threadgroup memory; the qmr family (the default since NI_QMM) removed that, which is where their +19-21% 27B prefill claim comes from. (5) Kapitsa's decode dequant is exactly the shift-free masked form our decision-table item 6 prototyped (x pre-scaled by 2^-(BITS*j)); its qmvhts Apple10 variant is the shifted-nibble counterpart. (6) No function constants or shape baking anywhere in these kernels: shapes enter through the grid and a params struct, matching our doc's 'shape baking via function constants; kapitsa has none'. (7) NI_QMM8=1 keeps the trunk's MoE router and shared-expert gate on qmm_b8 because 8-bit there changes routing near-ties (p4000 logits KL 2e-4 for ~0.3%), an upstream-accepted trade on the M5 Pro for the qmt path. (8) The qmt/qmt6 tensor-unit prefill and the ANE-split qmm_b4_m64_n64_ld view belong to other entries' territory; they appear here only as the gates that divert shapes away from qmr.
